meta_description: South Liverpool Electrical provides expert electrical installation and repair services across Liverpool. Fast, reliable, fully certified. Call 07765 133756 today.
hero_eyebrow: NICEIC Certified — Fast & Reliable Electrical Work
hero_subhead: From faulty sockets to complete rewires, we fix electrical problems fast and keep your home safe.
services_subhead: Whether you need urgent repairs, new installations, or a full safety inspection, we've got you covered.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped electrics, or dead sockets? We diagnose and fix the problem on the same day, keeping your home running safely.

services.title: New Electrics & Rewires
services.desc: Full house rewires and new installations to modern standards. We handle the planning, testing, and certification so you don't have to.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Replace outdated fuse boxes with modern consumer units. Safer, more efficient, and compliant with current regulations.

services.title: Lighting Installation
services.desc: From spotlights and pendant lights to outdoor garden lighting. We design, install, and test everything to spec.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Intermittent faults and electrical niggles tracked down and fixed. EICR certificates issued so you know your home is safe.

services.title: Power & Socket Installation
services.desc: Add new power sockets, USB outlets, and dedicated circuits for kitchens and bathrooms. Buried safely behind walls or surface-mounted to your preference.

about_pullquote: I built this business on doing the job right, first time, every time.
about_para_1: South Liverpool Electrical was founded in 2006 by a team committed to bringing honest, straightforward electrical work to South Liverpool and beyond. With nearly two decades in the trade, we've earned the trust of hundreds of local families and businesses by turning up on time, explaining what we're doing, and charging fair prices.
about_para_2: We're NICEIC certified and pride ourselves on treating every customer like a neighbour—because in Liverpool, we are. We don't use high-pressure sales tactics or hide behind jargon. Our repeat customers come back because they know we'll do a proper job, give them a realistic quote, and leave their home cleaner than when we arrived.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Called South Liverpool Electrical on a Saturday evening when our lights went out. They arrived within the hour and found a faulty switch causing the whole circuit to trip. Fixed it straightaway and wouldn't overcharge us. Can't ask for more than that. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a complete rewire done earlier this year. The lads were tidy, efficient, and professional throughout. They explained everything as they went and sorted out a few extra niggles we mentioned without faffing about charging extra. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Helen W.

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Consumer unit was getting old and we were worried about safety. They came, did a full test, advised us what needed doing, and gave a fair quote. Job done in a day. Really reassuring to know the electrics are safe now.
reviews.author: Paul D.
